$comment: [[D-PP-SKIPPED-CONDITIONAL-GROUP-VALIDATED-AS-A-PHASE-7-NUMBER]] runtime witness. A skipped conditional group's text is divided into preprocessing tokens and NOT otherwise processed (C 6.10.1p6); `2d`, `1e` and `0x1e+2` are valid preprocessing numbers (C 6.4.8) that convert to no numeric literal, so they are errors ONLY in phase 7. DSS ran the phase-7 numeric grammar over the skipped text and refused the whole TU (P_MalformedNumber), which is the shape upstream sqlite's `#if 0` Tcl script in src/printf.c hits. prints "skipped", exits 42. The observable behaviour is the coarsest available -- the program compiles and runs at all -- so a regression produces NO artifact and the harness fails on the build, not on the comparison.
$commentWhyNotVacuous: The live half is NOT decoration. `0x1e` is the exact spelling whose preprocessing-number tail would absorb a following `+2`; keeping it live proves the retiming did not disturb the phase-7 literal grammar, since a mangled `0x1e` changes the exit code from 42. The unit pins in tests/analysis/preprocess/test_skipped_group_not_otherwise_processed.cpp carry the other direction (a LIVE `2d` must STILL be refused) -- neither half is provable from the other.
